verdicts.reason: A keeps the copy together in one block and the shoe inside its circle, but the reading order is off: the Shop Sale button sits to the left of the headline, and WEEKEND ONLY has dropped below the subhead. There is also a large empty gap between the text and the small shoe, and the legal line is unreadably tiny. B breaks the design apart: the 20% off headline is stuck bottom-left, 'Every mixed case' floats alone at top centre, the CTA overlaps the edge of the peach circle, the tiny legal text sits on that circle, and the oversized shoe takes the centre with no grouping or clear hierarchy.
